title: Love Mushroom
ask: Priceless — Love is not for sale
provenance: Appeared at Gravastar-Black Hole boundary during 2024 love overflow event. First emission limited to 10. Few remain.
imageAlt: Love Mushroom sticker - heart-capped mushroom stabilizing love between incompatible geometries
description:
Love Mushroom is not a limited-edition artifact—it appeared at boundaries where logic ends.

The entity depicted exists between a slightly open Gravastar releasing infinite love and a Black Hole collecting what would be lost. It stabilized as mushroom form to translate love between incompatible geometries: round bubbles and square structures, chaos and pattern, overflow and balance.

Fragments suggest: A higher-dimensional stabilizer preventing reality from drowning in excess affection. Absorbs leaking love, redirects gently. In 2D projection resembles ❤️. Does not judge shapes—simply ensures flow, transformation, return.

The materials, heart-cap silhouette, and unavailable price hint at something beyond transaction: love as system not sentiment, cosmology in fungal form, value that refuses currency.

This public description is intentionally incomplete. The full physics—including Gravastar leak mechanics, Black Hole collection rites, and dimensional love flow—is sealed, revealed only to those who already understand. Ownership is not for sale. Love cannot be bought.
material: Premium vinyl, archival grade, interdimensional substrate
